task: Independent source-only semantic TRAIN annotation of both allowed label-free packets
elapsed_measurement: Observed wall time from first local shell timestamp to report completion; the final chat response follows this timestamp.

model_provenance.reviewer: Inherited workhorse fallback model in this session

runtime_libraries: Python standard library and installed jsonschema used only as execution/validation dependencies; no additional task data or annotation sources consulted.
source_read_scope: Only the two allowlisted packets and the allowlisted schema. Own newly generated helpers and annotations were read for validation. No other source/review files were read.

context_fields: question role/text/target indices/security field where present
source_inspection.identity_and_hash_metadata: Source identity/revision/hash fields remain in canonical binding; compact inspection display omitted repeated nonsemantic identity metadata.
source_inspection.pending_facts: Context only; not reannotated as dates or proposals in the new utterance.

annotation_before_adjudication.adjudication: None; no author, peer, human, model-prediction or other-review comparison was performed.
annotation_before_adjudication.integrity_limit: Snapshot is a real separate byte artifact. Its hash is an integrity identifier, not independent proof of provenance or correctness.

validation.json_schema: Draft 2020-12; supplied independent_source_review_supplement.v5 schema validated separately for each packet and identically embedded frozen annotations
validation.semantic_limits: Schema and integrity validation do not prove semantic judgments, exhaustive DATE recall, maximal semantic boundaries, privacy policy compliance or human consensus.

process_constraints.local_operations: Local exec_command and apply_patch for allowlisted reads, new helper/annotation writes and validation; clock for elapsed-time observations.
process_constraints.ignored_status: The user-designated ignored helper location was used; Git was prohibited, so ignore configuration was not inspected.

limitations: Synthetic engineering annotations; not human/IID gold, financial advice, normalized payment authority or bank-policy ground truth.
Inherited fallback reviewer model; GPT-5.6 identity was not verified.
Ambiguous dominant acts remain ambiguous and primary_observed=false; no positive/negative count target was imposed.
Empty DATE candidate arrays do not assert absence. Any omitted DATE candidate remains unassessed.

Pause durations and ordinary dialogue sequencing (for a moment, quiet minute, before answering, first/next) were not encoded as calendar DATE expressions. Vague arrival early and discussion later were retained as ambiguous DATE surfaces.

Dependent operands, range endpoints, open alternatives, corrections, quotations, negation and conditional expressions are retained in maximal contiguous spans. Nested operands are not emitted as duplicate maximal candidates.
An intervening aside is included in the maximal contiguous span for the second Monday of ... November. A before/after fragment retains competing direction readings without choosing one.
No current calendar, unstated year, event date, working-day convention, parent history or reference antecedent was invented. Completion is distinct from resolution and validity.
A mentioned product can be the event anchor for another product date; anchor mentions were not automatically assigned as additional proposal targets.
Privacy eligibility was independently assessed on these nonidentifying authored-fixture utterances; it is not inferred solely from an account verification phase.
No external adjudication was performed; semantic recall and correctness remain reviewer judgments.
Conflicting parallel-agent authorization/prohibition was resolved by using this isolated session only.
